content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can set up a fully operational online store today using the Edge Commerce Stack. This stack utilizes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. You can deploy your store with up to five products in just 48 hours. By choosing to accept cryptocurrency, you bypass traditional banking barriers. Transactions in USDT on the Tron network settle in under 60 seconds, ensuring your customers can purchase without delay for a minimal fee.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is your optimal choice for launching a digital product store. It includes everything you need: Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for logic, Supabase for database management, and NOWPayments for crypto transaction processing. This stack is designed for creators locked out of traditional payment systems. With SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured, your emails will land in inboxes, ensuring customers receive important communications. The stack is end-to-end tested before handoff, giving you peace of mind as you go live.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on the essentials and avoid getting bogged down by non-critical tasks. For instance, you don't need to worry about extensive marketing campaigns or complicated product logistics right now. Start with a simple product offering and iterate as you gain traction. Use the resources available through the Edge Commerce Stack to streamline your deployment process. Embrace the simplicity of the tools at your disposal, and prioritize getting live transactions flowing.
Infrastructural sovereignty means you own everything after deployment.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Once your store is set up, test your payment processing with a small transaction. Use a cryptocurrency like USDT on the Tron network for its low fees and fast settlement times. Make sure to verify that your NOWPayments integration works flawlessly. This initial transaction will validate your setup and give you confidence in your new infrastructure. Don’t hesitate to reach out for support if questions arise; you have 30 days of assistance included.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, focus on deploying your Edge Commerce Stack. First, register for the necessary services: Cloudflare, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Create your product listings and ensure your digital files are ready for delivery. After your store is live, promote it on social media channels, targeting your audience effectively. Leverage Binance P2P to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions if needed, as it supports local currencies like the peso. This proactive approach will help you gain traction quickly.

Filipino creators can sell digital products to international buyers using blockchain-based payment processors like NOWPayments. This platform allows for transactions in various cryptocurrencies with low fees and no KYC requirements, making it accessible for everyone. By leveraging Cloudflare infrastructure, creators can establish a reliable online store without reliance on traditional payment gateways.
No subscriptions or hidden fees—just straightforward ownership.

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a powerful solution to bypass traditional payment barriers. For immediate access to the tools you need, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This variety allows you to cater to a global audience and minimizes transaction costs.
How fast are transactions processed?
Transactions using USDT on the Tron network settle in under 60 seconds, ensuring swift confirmation for your customers. This rapid processing allows for a seamless purchasing experience.
Can I use local currencies for transactions?
Yes, with Binance P2P, you can conduct transactions in local currencies such as the peso, naira, and cedis. This option provides flexibility and accessibility for you and your customers.
What support is included after deployment?
When you purchase the Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support to help you troubleshoot any issues that arise. This ensures you can operate your store confidently.
Is my data secure with this setup?

Yes, using Cloudflare's infrastructure provides a secure environment for your store. You maintain full data ownership and have control over your transactions without reliance on third-party platforms.
